subtitle: Android TV 4K Set Top Box
overview: The TL-4KBR is a Google-certified Android TV set-top box that turns any TV or monitor into a smart display over a single HDMI connection. Powered by Android 11 and the Amlogic S905X4 chipset, it is built for professional deployments in hotels, cruise ships, and other managed environments.

The Android TV interface is fast and familiar, with Chromecast and Google Assistant built in. Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, and YouTube come pre-installed with shortcut buttons on the remote, while the full Google Play catalogue keeps content open — without compromising operator control.

With 4K Ultra HD and HDR support and broad codec coverage up to 4Kx2K at 60fps, the device delivers crisp visuals and clear Dolby Digital Plus audio. Dual-band Wi-Fi 5, Ethernet, and Bluetooth 5.0 cover reliable deployment across wired and wireless setups.

Its compact 114 x 114 x 22 mm form factor installs discreetly behind displays or inside cabinets, and plug-and-play setup makes it easy to deploy at scale. Centralised management lets operators configure and monitor the estate remotely, streamlining support and reducing truck rolls.

rows: AV1, VP9, H.265 HEVC, AVS2-P2, H.264 AVC/MVC, MPEG-1/2/4, WMV/VC-1, RealVideo 8/9/10 — up to 4Kx2K@60fps
